question: What dark substance is accessed by resorting to the abode of the yogini?
premises: One resorts to the place of the yogini.
A substance is found or accessed there.
That substance is dark and black in color.
inference: By resorting to the yogini's abode, one accesses a dark, black-colored substance.
plain_english: Having resorted to the abode of the yogini, one finds the dark, black-colored substance.
